podcast.body: This early 1983 hit was central to a pivotal moment in MTV's history. Legend holds that MTV, which was largely refusing to play videos by black artists, only began to regularly rotate clips by black artists after CBS records threatened to withhold all their videos unless "Billie Jean" was played. "Legend has it that the channel largely refused to play videos by black artists before CBS records threatened to withhold all of their videos unless MTV played Jackson's early 1983 hit Billy Jean."
